title: ecliptic elixir frenetic fixer for the mixer of snicker when one lifts a knicker Or a flickr of of hope no rope of fire but threads of desire CONTROL
summary: ecliptic elixir frenetic fixer for the mixer of snicker when one lifts a knicker Or a flickr of of hope no rope of fire but threads of desire CONTROL CHOICE voice elixir of soul #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
ecliptic elixir
frenetic fixer
for the mixer
of snicker
when one lifts a
knicker
Or
a flickr of
of hope
no rope
of fire but
threads
of
desire
CONTROL
CHOICE
voice
elixir
of soul

#smallpoems
